title: Talk it through 2.5
role: Delegate dealing with official and legal matters and running a meeting
can_do: I can report a theft and deal with a consulate or an embassy.
I can open, run and close a meeting and ask for a summary of reasons.

nodes.partner_line: Police station, good morning. How can I assist you?
nodes.translation: Comisaría, buenos días. ¿En qué puedo ayudarle?

options.text: I would like to report a theft. My laptop was stolen last night.
I am here to report that my bag was taken from the hotel lobby.
Good morning. My documents were stolen this morning.

nodes.partner_line: Where and when did it happen?
nodes.model_reply: It was stolen from the hotel at about nine.

nodes.partner_line: You will also need a new passport. Have you contacted your embassy?
nodes.translation: También necesitará un nuevo pasaporte. ¿Contactó a su embajada?

options.text: Not yet. Could you tell me how to reach the consulate?
I called them, but nobody answered.
Yes, they asked me to bring the police report.

nodes.partner_line: Now to the meeting. I am pleased to open this session. Shall we start?
nodes.translation: Pasemos a la reunión. Me complace abrir esta sesión. ¿Empezamos?

options.text: Yes, please. Could you present the agenda first?
Of course. We have a full agenda today.
Certainly. Let us begin with the first item.

nodes.partner_line: Could you provide a summary of your reasons for the proposal?
nodes.translation: ¿Podría ofrecer un resumen de sus razones para la propuesta?

options.text: Certainly. In brief, it reduces costs and improves service.
Of course. There are three main reasons.
Gladly. I will summarise the key points.

nodes.partner_line: Thank you. As time is up, I will now close the session.
nodes.translation: Gracias. Como se acabó el tiempo, daré por terminada la sesión.

options.text: Thank you, Chair. Will the minutes be circulated?
Thank you. We will continue next week.
Understood. We will send our comments in writing.
